## Overview & Bio
Rajjit Laishram is a systems and software developer specializing in drone software stacks, custom Ground Control Station (GCS) software, autonomous flight routines, and AI integration pipelines. His experience spans embedded systems, edge AI, LoRaWAN/Satellite IoT networks, and full-stack web applications.
